title: Ponderous, Truly Ponderous
description: Ponderous, Truly Ponderous — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to Purpose-Pondering Peak off Level 7 of MutantMania. Pound Dangerous Dmitri and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Purpose-Pondering Peak off Level 7 of MutantMania. Pound Dangerous Dmitri and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Friend, Ah booked you another fight in Purpose-Pondering Peak. You're going up against Dangerous Dmitri this time. They say he's never met a fighter he doesn't like. Then again, they say he's never met a fighter he hasn't beat.

Turn-in:

Friend, I'm told that Dangerous Dmitri likes your style. His manager says you're beating him actually brought in a nice chunk of change. Let me know when you're ready, because the two of us want to schedule another fight between the two of you.

Objectives:

  • Pound Dangerous Dmitri

Client level range: 88–98
